cross.generativity: Yes. All six converged on the same seams: a Map of slot records closed over by createScheduler, one waiting and one running record per slot, a pump that starts live slots before background ones (A/B/C/D/E/F at impl-A/src/index.ts:189, impl-B/src/index.ts:229, impl-C/src/index.ts:161, impl-D/src/index.ts:236, impl-E/src/index.ts:259, impl-F/src/index.ts:244), an aborted flag on the running record, a re-entrancy guard (all except F), try/catch walls around user callbacks, and adoption by key+pass. They differ in detail on four axes. (1) Present rule: shownGeneration comparison (A, B, C, D, F) versus 'serves newest or presentAnyway' (impl-E/src/index.ts:208-209). (2) Adoption: the generation is bumped (A, B, D, F) or not (C, E). (3) Close: the slot stays occupied until the render settles (B, D, E, F) or is detached (A, C, which allows two renders per slot after a reopen). (4) Close releases the shown result (B, F) or not (A, C, D, E). The lane is per request in A, C and E, per slot in B, and per slot with a sticky default in D and F.
cross.worse_is_better: Sizes are within 15% of each other (304 to 350 source lines), so there is no dramatic worse-is-better result. The smallest, D (304 lines), reaches the quality of B and F with a single Work type and a single settle(). It spends its savings on two hacks (impl-D/src/index.ts:155-161, impl-D/src/index.ts:248) and has the weakest tests. The largest, A (350 lines), is the only one whose extra machinery (detached/counted/inFlight, impl-A/src/index.ts:61-63, impl-A/src/index.ts:87) buys nothing and introduces the close/reopen overlap. The yardstick did not inflate any implementation: none built the bridge, target chooser or cache.
ideas_the_yardstick_lacks: Release the replaced result only after the new one has been presented, so the on-screen buffer is never freed first (impl-E/src/index.ts:236-242); the sketch's order is release then present

A per-run 'must present' flag (presentAnyway) set by the progress rule and revoked by abort, instead of relying only on generation comparison (impl-E/src/index.ts:67, impl-E/src/index.ts:124, impl-E/src/index.ts:303)
